test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following has become IAF’s first woman fighter pilot from J&K?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mawya Sudan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mawya Sudan** has become the** first woman fighter pilot in the Indian Air Force (IAF)** from the Rajouri district of **Jammu & Kashmir.**
 
• Hailing from the village of** Lamberi,** Nowshera in Rajouri, **she is commissioned into the IAF as Flying Officer.**
 
• Mawya has become the **12th woman officer** and the **first from Rajouri **to be inducted as a** combat pilot **within the pilot in the IAF.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​India Air Force is the** fourth largest** in the world after the **USA, China and Russia.**
 
• **Headquarters: New Delhi**
 
• The motto of the IAF is ‘**Touch the Sky with Glory**’.
 
• **The President of India** holds the rank of Supreme Commander of the air force.
 
• Air Force in India was officially raised in **1932**. 
 
• Raising Day of **Indian Air Force - 8th October.**
